title: draba maritima
intro: Draba maritima, commonly known as searocket, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Draba maritima include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties.
